messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency spike for model-serving-prod (us-west-2). p99 ~ 4.2s, p95 ~ 1.1s, 5xx rate 6% over 5m window. Affected route: /v1/generate. 

alice: I see the spike. Recent deploy at 3851232000 to release/2026-03-15-e. Can someone confirm canary status?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 3851232000 — canary=25% -> healthy checks were green at start. No automatic abort.

ben: @sre-oncall ping — taking triage.

sre-oncall: on it. grabbing dashboards (latency heatmap + 5xx breakdown).

carla: quick check: traces show tail serialization stall in kv-cache fetch path, appears around model kv hit-miss boundary.

alice: running a quick curl against a few nodes, I get timeouts:
```
# sample repro against node
curl -v -X POST https://model-serving.us-west-2.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' --max-time 10
# response: hangs ~4s then 504/gateway timeout
```

darren: Can we abort the canary and cut traffic back to previous version? If this is regresssion we should rollback.

ben: Agree. Repro across nodes and traces point at a change in kv path from this release. Recommend abort canary then rollback.

deploy-bot: Received abort request. Aborting canary and shifting traffic to release/2026-03-14-d (stable). Executing traffic-shift now.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete. oldStable -> 100% at 3851233123. Starting rollback orchestration for release/2026-03-15-e.

incident-bot: Paging: oncall escalation to darren and alice. Customer-impact: some active requests returned 504/502, estimated customer error-rate ~8% of requests in the window. Flagging P1 and notifying CS.

cs-notify-bot: Notifying customer success team and queued outbound comms template "service-degradation" for review.

alice: Monitoring metrics now. p99 down to ~220ms, 5xx under 0.5% after rollback — looks like rollback mitigated.

sre-oncall: Confirming broader region checks and synthetic probes. us-west-2 synthetics green for 3 mins. Will keep watch for 15m.

carla: Captured pod logs and a small sample of failing traces before rollback — attaching snippet: 
```
E 03-15T12:34:02.123 model_infer.py:KvCache miss -> backend fetch 4123ms
E 03-15T12:34:02.125 grpc: deadline exceeded
```

ben: Good catch. Put an eval job to replay failed traces against previous and new release to isolate regression.

darren: Oncall handoff note: I'm taking lead for the remainder of mitigation and postmortem. @alice stay as primary for rollback follow-ups. Setting incident channel to readonly for postmortem artifacts.

alice: Thanks — I'll start collecting deploy diff & kernel flags changed in this release.

sre-oncall: Adding immediate mitigations to runbook: 1) rollback (done), 2) disable new kv prefetch flag, 3) temporarily increase request deadline to 12s for high-latency callers as bridge (if needed).

carla: We should also schedule a targeted replay test with production traces to confirm fix before re-rolling.

ben: I've opened an internal task: infra-2879 to triage kv fetch path. Adding owners: carla, alice.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (rollback complete, traffic restored). Customer impact: partial (some requests timed out); severity P1 -> downgrade to P2 for postmortem coordination.

cs-notify-bot: CS brief: initial notice sent to affected customers, follow-up email draft ready awaiting postmortem details.

darren: Final checks: traces stable, no sustained 5xx. I'll keep channel open for 30m then move to postmortem thread. If anyone sees reappearance, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

alice: saving logs + deploy diffs to incident ticket. Will post link in postmortem.

carla: quick TODOs before close: collect flamegraphs for kv path, share perf regression test results, confirm whether new kernel selection change landed.

ben: thanks team. Closing mitigation phase. Postmortem owners: darren (lead), alice + carla (tech), ben (comms).

sre-oncall: closing watch window, marking incident resolved in pager duty when stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived for follow-up. Remember to create RFC if fix requires config flag gating.
